mkdir .toolbox
mkdir .toolbox/tasks
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/hello.yaml .toolbox/tasks/hello.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/examples/.toolbox/config.yaml .toolbox/config.yaml

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN list
stdout 'hello'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run hello
stdout 'Status: ok'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run hello --json
stdout '"ok": true'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN doctor
stdout 'doctor: ok'
